name: mobile-shipkit
description: From create-expo-app to both app stores: EAS build failure casebook, OTA fingerprint discipline, Google Play submission with gpc, App Store gotchas on top of asc, five-step screenshot pipeline with AI assets and a review gate, two-store listing copy, and app-scout market scans (geo-gap / zombies / weak / paid-gap) to pick what to build. Distilled from a real dual-store submission.
